headline: Turkish Airport Passenger Traffic Rises 2.5% in First 10 Months
summary: Passenger traffic at Türkiye’s airports rose 2.5% year-on-year to 216.8 million in the first 10 months of 2026, with Istanbul’s two main airports handling over half of the total.
why: Airport passenger volume growth serves as a primary performance metric for the aviation, tourism, and transport infrastructure sectors.

impacts.name: Turkish Aviation Sector
impacts.why: Passenger traffic across national airports increased year-on-year.
